nodes.text: Wendy yanks the phone away!

nodes.speaker: Veronica
nodes.text: It's okay, Wendy. 'Cause now's when the fun really begins!
Veronica lunges forward, shoving the trash bin over! Garbage spills out all over the floor!
The commotion brings over the other students serving community service time.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: What's going on over here?!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Duh! This fake blonde girl is picking on what's her name!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Thanks for clearing that up!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: I saw the whole thing! Veronica here tried to threaten $ALLISON into giving a false confession about this morning, but $ALLISON refused so Veronica knocked over the trash!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Not cool. Red, you want me to do something about `this` piece of trash?
nodes.text_bbcode: Not cool. Red, you want me to do something about [color=#e23b3b][i]this[/i][/color] piece of trash?

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: No... It's okay... I--

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: --Yeah! Let's carefully sweep her up with a dust pan and gently put her into a recycling bin!
Everyone stares at Erik.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: What? I don't do angry very well...
Kimi turns back to Veronica.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Who do you think you are, picking on her? You should try picking on someone your own status!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Kimi... Please... I'm--

nodes.speaker: Veronica
nodes.text: --My own status? What? You think you're on the same level as me? You're the girl who embarrassed herself with that stupid online video.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: I'm also the girl who knows pretty much everything about fashion. FYI, that top you're wearing was last season, like, `last season.`
nodes.text_bbcode: I'm also the girl who knows pretty much everything about fashion. FYI, that top you're wearing was last season, like, [color=#3b78e2][i]last season.[/i][/color]

nodes.text: Veronica fumes.

nodes.speaker: Veronica
nodes.text: All of you shut up!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: What?! Did this pathetic nobody just tell `me` to shut up?!
nodes.text_bbcode: What?! Did this pathetic nobody just tell [color=#3b78e2][i]me[/i][/color] to shut up?!

nodes.text: $ALLISON holds up her hand.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Paige! It's okay! I'll handle this...
Veronica points at the garbage.

nodes.speaker: Veronica
nodes.text: That's right, you `will` handle this. Clean it up. By yourself. Now.
nodes.text_bbcode: That's right, you [color=#3b78e2][i]will[/i][/color] handle this. Clean it up. By yourself. Now.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: No, I don't think I will, Veronica.

nodes.speaker: Veronica
nodes.text: Excuse me?

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: I also don't think I will bother with repeating myself to you.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: You seem determined to make my life a 'nightmare', even after I told you I would be leaving Cameron alone as a courtesy to you.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: You've bullied me, but today marks the end of that--

nodes.speaker: Veronica
nodes.text: Pfft. You mean `the start.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Pfft. You mean [color=#3b78e2][i]the start.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Allow me to explain... Because I've decided to become `your` nightmare.
nodes.text_bbcode: Allow me to explain... Because I've decided to become [color=#3b78e2][i]your[/i][/color] nightmare.

nodes.speaker: Veronica
nodes.text: I'm not afraid of you.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: But you should be... Because 'your man' was flirting with me today.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: And if someone as socially clueless as I am knows that he was flirting, you're in trouble.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: If you are even half as annoying to him as you are to me, it will not be long before he talks to me more and more `and more...`
nodes.text_bbcode: If you are even half as annoying to him as you are to me, it will not be long before he talks to me more and more [color=#3b78e2][i]and more...[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Veronica
nodes.text: You wouldn't dare...

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: I would. And another thing. I didn't break your arm today as the whole school seems to think...

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: But I am a registered blue belt in judo, which means your arm isn't broken because I `chose` to keep it that way.
nodes.text_bbcode: But I am a registered blue belt in judo, which means your arm isn't broken because I [color=#3b78e2][i]chose[/i][/color] to keep it that way.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: That means you don't lay a hand on me again...

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: `I` am a Troublemaker.
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]I[/i][/color] am a Troublemaker.

nodes.speaker: Veronica
nodes.text: W-W-Whatever...
Veronica and Wendy hurry out of the cafeteria, and $ALLISON turns to face the rest of the group. Their mouths are all hanging open in stunned silence.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Is something wrong?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: That was the coolest thing I've ever seen!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: You burned that girl! `Hard!`
nodes.text_bbcode: You burned that girl! [color=#e23b3b][i]Hard![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I feel all tingly everywhere!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Wait... What's your name?

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: $ALLISON...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: It's nice to meet you, $ALLISON. I think we'll all be staying on your good side... Starting with helping you pick this mess up.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I'll go fetch my tongs! The best part of a trash spill is that you get to pick up trash again!
A few minutes later, all the trash has been collected, and the garbage can is once again filled.
Ms. Lee comes in.

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: Great work, Troublemakers! You can all go home!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Do we have to sign something that says we're done with our community service?

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: Done? Who said anything about being done?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: You did. Just now.

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: Oh, how adorable you students sometimes are! You thought your community service punishment was one day?!
The students all nod.

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: What kind of punishment would that be?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: A fair one?

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: Hardly. No, Rome wasn't built in a day, so let's not rush the rehabilitation of your corrupted souls.

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: In fact, like Rome, the process will take about thirty days!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: A month?!

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: Or you could be suspended. Which would you prefer?

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: This isn't one of your jokes again, is it?

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: Look at my face.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: I didn't think so...

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: Anyway, you'd better get buddy-buddy, because you're going to be spending quite a bit of time together!
The group groans as they gather their things and leave the cafeteria, side by side.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Wait a minute... `Buddy-buddy?

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Did I just make `friends?`
nodes.text_bbcode: Did I just make [color=#3b78e2][i]friends?[/i][/color]

nodes.text: You have reached the end of `Season 1, Episode 1: Troublemakers!`
nodes.text_bbcode: You have reached the end of [b]Season 1, Episode 1: Troublemakers![/b]

$ALLISON clears her throat before speaking into the phone.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Yes, I did flip Veronica with a judo move in the hallway this morning...

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: And I did it...

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: I did it for no reason. Completely unprovoked. And for that...
Wendy moves the microphone closer to $ALLISON's mouth, encouraging her...

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: For that, I'm very sorry.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: You see...

nodes.speaker: Veronica
nodes.text: We got it! Come on, Wendy!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Wait, but I thought...
Veronica and Wendy hurry out of the cafeteria, leaving $ALLISON worried...

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: That was particularly suspicious...
The next day...
As $ALLISON walks alone down the hall, the P.A. system crackles to life, and $ALLISON's recorded message comes blaring out!

nodes.speaker: P.A. System
nodes.text: Yes, I did flip Veronica... I did it for no reason. Completely unprovoked.
Everyone turns to $ALLISON. The hall grows quiet.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: That's... That's not the whole message! I apologized!

nodes.speaker: P.A. System
nodes.text: I am...

nodes.speaker: P.A. System
nodes.text: `NOT.`
nodes.text_bbcode: [i]NOT.[/i]

nodes.speaker: P.A. System
nodes.text: ...Very sorry.
Several students shake their heads. Others hustle away from $ALLISON in fear.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: No! That obviously wasn't me! Well, okay, the first and last parts were...

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Can no one hear that that was someone else's voice?!
Veronica calls out from the other end of the hall!

nodes.speaker: Veronica
nodes.text: Everybody, run! This is exactly how she was acting before she attacked me!
Suddenly, the students in the hall rush out in a stampede of panic!
A moment later, Veronica and $ALLISON are all that remain...

nodes.speaker: Veronica
nodes.text: Told you. I'm your nightmare. And this is just the beginning...

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Great...
As $ALLISON contemplates what her high school life will be like, it's painfully clear that...
$ALLISON clears her throat before speaking into the phone.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Yes, I did flip Veronica with a judo move in the hallway this morning...

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: But I did it...
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Because she completely deserved it!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: You seem to be harboring feelings of anger toward... Owen, is it? Over this most recent break up.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: The trick is to spend as little time together as possible!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: News flash! That's what we've `been` doing!
nodes.text_bbcode: News flash! That's what we've [color=#3b78e2][i]been[/i][/color] doing!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: We don't exactly have that option at the moment...

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Oh, well, since neither of you have any feelings for the other, I advise a system of completely severed communication!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: That seems... Hard...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I wouldn't have any problems with it!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Neither would I!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Next time you want to send a spy, send someone with a functioning brain!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: You think I care about your secrets enough to send Spencer?! You really are full of it sometimes!
Paige stands up, indignant!
$ALLISON sees her opportunity and steps forward!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Ahem! I think I might be able to clear up this whole entanglement!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: It's not your business, freshman!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Well, I realize I might be overstepping my bounds, but the answer here seems unbearably simple.
Paige crosses her arms over her chest, fuming. Erik steps as far away from $ALLISON as possible.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Doesn't it?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Speak!
$ALLISON moves `away` from Paige and Kimi, focused on cleaning up the trash!
nodes.text_bbcode: $ALLISON moves [b]away[/b] from Paige and Kimi, focused on cleaning up the trash!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I admire your ethic, but I think you've lost sight of your mission, fellow spy!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Oh, right... I'm not sure what came over me...
Erik puts a hand on $ALLISON's shoulder.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Trash fever. It affects us all.
Paige's voice suddenly raises, directed at Owen!
$ALLISON raises her head, tuning into Paige and Kimi's conversation...
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: I can hear everything!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: No offense, but... This new look of yours...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: What about it?!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: It's super hot, don't get me wrong.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: But?!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: But don't you think you're just angry at Owen? He broke up with you!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: When someone breaks up with you, they probably don't have any feelings for you...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: But you, like, still totally have feelings for them!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Are you trying to make me feel worse?!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: No, I'm just saying... If you still love him, why don't you take it easy on him?

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Good advice!
On the other side of the table, $ALLISON notices Spencer slowly moving closer to the girls as he mops.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Looks like I'm not the only spy!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: He's clearly hurting. I mean, have you ever seen him study this hard before?!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: He's being an idiot, don't you see that?! He only broke up with me because of money!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: So... What are you saying then?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Yeah, what are you saying?!
The girls suddenly break out of their conspiratorial huddle!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Uh, I mean... Get clean... Puddle!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Real believable cover there, Spence!
Paige glares past Spencer at Owen!
$ALLISON moves `away` from Paige and Kimi, focused on cleaning up the trash!
nodes.text_bbcode: $ALLISON moves [b]away[/b] from Paige and Kimi, focused on cleaning up the trash!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I admire your ethic, but I think you've lost sight of your mission, fellow spy!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Oh, right... I'm not sure what came over me...
Erik puts a hand on $ALLISON's shoulder.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Trash fever. It affects us all.
Paige's voice suddenly raises, directed at Owen!
Unsure of what to do, $ALLISON just continues to clean!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: You're eavesdropping on me, aren't you?!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Me? I am just picking up trash. I can't help it if you are being too loud.
Paige glares at $ALLISON before resuming her conversation with Kimi, albeit at a much quieter volume.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Did you forget the code?!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: No!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Maybe...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Well, now we'll have to wait a little bit for the heat to die down!
A few minutes later...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Okay! Jam and toast! Jam and toast!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Owen and I aren't together because--
Paige's attention snaps to $ALLISON!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Spying on me again?! Really?! Don't you have anything better to do?!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Like attacking innocent people?!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: I... I'm sorry.
$ALLISON embarrassingly returns her attention to picking up trash.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I guess you're not cut out for spy work.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: I guess not...
A few moments later, Paige raises her voice at Owen!
$ALLISON keeps her head down, picks up a burrito wrapper, and puts it into the trash bin.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: { She's looking this waaaaaaay! {

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: { Fish stew is so gross to taaaaaste! {

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: { Good job, fellow spyyyyy! {
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Thanks... I think...

Paige's attention snaps to $ALLISON!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Spying on me again?! Really?! Don't you have anything better to do?!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Like attacking innocent people?!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: I... I'm sorry.
$ALLISON embarrassingly returns her attention to picking up trash.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I guess you're not cut out for spy work.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: I guess not...

Confused, $ALLISON stops working...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Owen and I aren't together because--
Paige's attention snaps to $ALLISON!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Spying on me again?! Really?! Don't you have anything better to do?!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Like attacking innocent people?!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: I... I'm sorry.
$ALLISON embarrassingly returns her attention to picking up trash.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I guess you're not cut out for spy work.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: I guess not...
A few moments later, Paige raises her voice at Owen!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: I suppose I won't risk it, then. Although this does feel like a golden opportunity to forge friendships.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Come again?

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: In an effort to make friends, I'm trying to emulate my whimsical sister. I'm certain she'd do whatever she could to bring this Paige and Owen duo back together.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I don't know... Paige and Owen are kinda--
Paige throws a sponge across the room!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I am ruining my black nail polish, and I'm not even supposed to be here!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: --Dramatic.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Still, I've always wanted to be a spy! I'd go by the name Derek Clericson, D.D.S.!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: You'd be a dentist spy?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: It's a complicated fantasy.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: How about I keep an eye on Paige? She never notices me anyway. When she's not looking, I'll say, 'Jam and toast!'

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: But when she `is` looking, I'll say, 'Fish stew!'
nodes.text_bbcode: But when she [color=#e23b3b][i]is[/i][/color] looking, I'll say, 'Fish stew!'

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Or you could say 'Not looking.' and 'Looking.'

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Too late! The code words are locked!
Erik turns, watching Paige out of the corner of his eye...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Fish stew! Fish stew!
$ALLISON lowers her head...
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: I feel silly. Why am I doing this?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Good, good. Keep talking!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: No. Seriously. `Why` am I keeping my head down?
nodes.text_bbcode: No. Seriously. [color=#3b78e2][i]Why[/i][/color] am I keeping my head down?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Oh. Because the `last` thing you want to do is get caught eavesdropping on Paige!
nodes.text_bbcode: Oh. Because the [color=#e23b3b][i]last[/i][/color] thing you want to do is get caught eavesdropping on Paige!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: It'd be like living in a world without smiles!
$ALLISON freezes up!
Paige stops talking to Kimi, noticing $ALLISON.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: What do you think you're doing?! Are you spying on us?!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Er... No! Sorry!
$ALLISON returns to trash duty...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Don't want to say 'I told you so'... But I kinda just did.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: I should've heeded your warning.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: That wasn't even the worst of it.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: If she was certain you were snooping, it'd be like living in a world without smiles!
After school, $ALLISON arrives in the cafeteria...
The place is a complete mess! The tables are covered with stains, trash is littered all over the floor, and in the corner, there's a growing puddle of spilled soda!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: What ate here? A bunch of infantile monkeys?
Ms. Lee stands near a table in the center of the cafeteria with five other students around her.
One of them, a rebellious-looking upperclassman, seems particularly angry.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Okay, Ms. Lee, Little Miss Violence finally showed. Can we `please` get this over with?!
nodes.text_bbcode: Okay, Ms. Lee, Little Miss Violence finally showed. Can we [color=#3b78e2][i]please[/i][/color] get this over with?!

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: Yes, I need to get home to watch my favorite show anyway. It's called Man Island, and I can't `wait` to see what hunk will wash ashore today!
nodes.text_bbcode: Yes, I need to get home to watch my favorite show anyway. It's called Man Island, and I can't [color=#3b78e2][i]wait[/i][/color] to see what hunk will wash ashore today!

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: Anyway, your task is to make this cafeteria spotless! I'll be back in an hour, and when I get back, I expect to see my reflection in every surface!

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: Bonus points if I look younger!
Ms. Lee hurries off, leaving the students by themselves...
A guy sitting far away from the rebel girl is the first to speak.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: So... How do we want to do this?
$ALLISON notices that his knuckles look bruised...
The first to answer is a small, nerdy kid.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Well, nothing gets my blood pumping more than picking up trash!
An angry, broad-shouldered guy speaks up.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Yeah, you can do that over there, weirdo... With the new girl.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Huzzah!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Owen. Let's mop up this soda spill. And if you spill any on my shoes...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I'm dead?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Big time.
A fashionable, brightly dressed girl pipes up!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Uh... Then I'll work with Paige cleaning up tables! That way things won't be awkward...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Unless I just made them awkward... Did I make them awkward? I'm saying awkward a lot...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: I'll shut up now...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Yeah, good idea!
Kimi whisks Paige away, and the two girls start scrubbing tables. Meanwhile, Spencer and Owen get to work tackling the soda spill.
Erik grabs a pair of trash tongs and starts picking the garbage up off the floor and putting it inside a trash can.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Kinda crazy about the two of them `breaking up,` huh?
nodes.text_bbcode: Kinda crazy about the two of them [color=#e23b3b][i]breaking up,[/i][/color] huh?

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Who?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Paige and Owen, of course! Happened in the last week of summer. When I heard, I cried for a week straight, and I'm not even in the relationship!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I heard Owen broke up with her. Since then, all he's been doing is working out and studying!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Meanwhile, Paige fell into a dark chasm of anger and rage...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Oh, look, lettuce! My third favorite leafy green!

Yeah, I'm fine... Just didn't know what to say...
I thought we were going to talk about my socks...
$ALLISON can't think of anything to say!
$ALLISON's day only gets worse from there...
This school district has a `no tolerance` policy when it comes to fighting!
And has repeatedly ignored requests to adopt my `some tolerance` policy!
So while I personally think students need to let off steam from time-to-time, professionally I'm required to suspend you. From school. `Forever.`
Just kidding! Ha! My therapist says I need to try using humor more!
And to stop making visits to his house...
Anyway, because you're a freshman and it's your first day and all, I'm putting you into our Troublemakers program.
The school's disciplinary program is called Troublemakers?
Heavens no! That's just my pet name for it. I think it's called the Behavior Outreach Remedial Institutional something something.
It doesn't matter, it's boring. You'll just be doing community service after school with the other bad apples. Meet in the cafeteria after school.
Yes, ma'am. And if I may add, I don't believe that I am guilty of fighting, per se. I was merely defending--
Ms. Lee looks up from a stack of papers on her desk.
What are you still doing here? Get to class, young lady!
In her Advanced English class, $ALLISON faces an impossible decision...
Since none of our sophomores seem to have done their summer reading...
I'll call on our alleged new freshman star, $ALLISON! Do you know the answer?
I know it, but I... I don't think I'll make many friends by answering...
I think I'll skip answering this particular question, Mr. Dean.
If you don't know the answer, just say so!
I don't know what I was expecting from an Applebee...
The theme of falling in Lord of the Flies represents the destruction of mankind.
Very good! That's exactly what I wanted to hear! At least someone in this class did the homework!
The rest of the class glares at her.
At lunch, she sits at a table by herself, hoping someone will sit down next to her...
...But as the students pass by, it's clear that false rumors have been spread about her fight with Veronica.
Would you want to sit next to her? She just attacked that sophomore Veronica for `no reason!`
I heard she's only here for like three months, and then she has to go back to prison.
OMG! There's that freshman black belt girl! I heard she, like, practically killed another girl before school this morning!
I heard that she only did it because the other girl said her hair looked like an ugly wig.
I don't blame her for getting mad. I've done worse for less.
She attacked her?! For that?! Are you serious?!
Serious. And all Veronica said was hi, but `apparently` Veronica didn't say it nice enough.
$ALLISON's project suddenly explodes, covering her clothes in a goopy liquid!
That should `not` have happened. I carefully measured out all the--
That's when $ALLISON notices Veronica and her friends, smiling at her deviously from a nearby table. Veronica holds up an empty vial and winks at $ALLISON.
Perhaps this class is `too` advanced for you Miss Applebee! It certainly was for your sister!
This class isn't too difficult for me, Mr. Russell, I assure you.
Uh huh. I'd take you more seriously if you didn't look like a disfigured cupcake. Go wash up... And come back here immediately afterward!
And in the restroom, as $ALLISON tries to clean herself up, she thinks of all the the ways that she's failed...
She imagines the pain of today and multiplies it out over the course of an entire year...
High school's so much worse than middle school. Everything's on a greater scale. Even the feelings.
She feels tears starting to form in her eyes, so she hides in a stall, shutting the door behind her. She cries softly into a thin tissue.
Her organizer app beeps at her, reminding her of her community service punishment, and she remembers that she can't even go home when she wants to...
Oh, yes... Great... I'm a Troublemaker...
Hey SHS Fans! It's the start of a new and exciting school year!
We just want to take the time to say thank you for all your support over the years, and hopefully...
The first day of a new year...
You are now playing as Amanda...
Amanda pulls her pink car up to the front of Twin Branches High School to drop off her freshman sister, Allison.
Eeep! I'm so excited for your first day! You're going to love it here!
Just look out the window! Each student is a friendship with a backpack!
And friendship means happiness and backpacks mean cookies!
As much as I appreciate your oft-hidden wisdom, big sister, I'm still filled with what I can only describe as a raging swarm of butterflies conspiring in my stomach toward my inevitable social end.
Are you doing that thing where you pretend to understand what I say?
Yes! But I still love you, Allison!
I... Appreciate you, too, but can you call me by my nickname like we discussed?
It's a psychological tactic. By creating a new identity, I can convince myself that I'm someone else, someone friendlier, someone decidedly `not` Allison.
Now, what name are you going to call me?
Good. $ALLISON is `much` friendlier. Plus I kind of like how it sounds.
I suppose you're right. $ALLISON is who I am... Even if I'm trying to be different.
But I don't understand... Why do you need to be someone different?
I think I can explain this to you...
Let's pretend that you saw a girl wearing a `really` ugly dress. What would you tell her?
I'd tell her that her hair looks really nice! It's so red, and I love her fins!
Are you, by chance, picturing a mermaid?
The point I'm trying to make is that you know how to make friends. It just comes naturally to you, like riding a bike.
It's not that way for me. Socializing for me is like riding a bike... With a blindfold on.
To put it simpler, if I saw the girl in the ugly dress, I'd tell her she was wearing an ugly dress.
Oh no! But that's how you create enemies! And then everyone thinks you're mean, and you have a stinky reputation!
That just about sums up middle school for me... A bad reputation, a lot of lonely lunches, and no friends.
Awww! You have plenty of friends, Allison... Er, $ALLISON.
And where are these alleged friends of mine? The ones who have never called? Or texted? Or posted a picture of me with my arm slung around them on the internet?
I know... They're probably just on vacation!
Your optimistic outlook is just further illustrating my point.
If you want friends, maybe you should--
I know. I know. I should be myself. And somehow, by being myself, I'll find people who will appreciate me for me...
People who read books, who understand that judo isn't something I take to be 'super cool'.
People who will actually like me for the overly analytical, occasionally awkward, bluntly honest girl I am!
Actually... I don't think that's such a good idea.
If you really haven't made friends being you, then maybe you could make friends being `me!`
Just think 'What would Amanda do?' and do it!
It's no different than using a new identity as a psychotic tactic!
Anyway, I've decided that today will be a success if I can end the day with just `one` friend.
Oh, you can totally do that! Good luck!
Luck isn't real!|Thank you for that expression!
Luck may very well be a crutch to lean on in both times of fortune and misfortune...
Regardless, you obviously meant it as a kind gesture.
And for that I am... Appreciative.
Amanda leans over and gives $ALLISON a hug!
Yeah, but 'appreciative' is $ALLISONspeak for 'I love you'!
$ALLISON gets out of the car, sees the ocean of students before her, and takes a deep, deep breath.
One friend. I can make one friend. It can't be `that` hard...
It's a crutch, Amanda. A way of making the randomness of the universe seem purposeful.
So... There's nothing I can do...
I just wanted to be nice.
I... I see that now, um...
Great, I can't even get a goodbye right with my sister!
Uh, didn't you...? Yeah... Never mind.
$ALLISON tries to keep her opinion quiet...
It's just that... Luck is not real!
In the hallway, $ALLISON clutches her books to her chest tightly, her eyes focused on the room numbers on each door...
B7, B8, B9... Where is it? What Neanderthal designed this schoo--
She walks right into a tall, muscular boy!
Her books fall to the floor in a heap! She immediately starts picking them up.
Great! I'm totally lost, I've dropped my books, and I don't know anyone. My impression of a stereotypical freshman is complete!
Also, I've managed to run into what I can only assume is some hulking, drooling, primordial caveman who--
She looks up, into the eyes of Cameron Clarke. He's holding her Advanced English textbook out for her.
--Who's impressed she's taking Advanced English as a freshman.
And if you're looking for B10, it's actually on the opposite end of the hall. Down that way.
$ALLISON rises, clutching her books tightly to her.
Impressed I can drool `and` speak in complete sentences? I'm Cameron.
Okay. Do `not` freak out. He's attractive, yes. He's also `very` attractive.
Why isn't my brain working? Keep it together, $ALLISON.
What's the matter? You were talking and then you got quiet... You're not concussed, are you?
I don't know why you'd come to that conclusion. I'm not exhibiting any of the symptoms of a concussion... No nausea, no blurred vision, impaired thinking maybe...
Then again, if I were concussed, would I be able to self-diagnose? It's actually quite a funny paradox!
Great... A guy is actually talking to me, and I turn into nerdy Dr. $ALLISON.
$ALLISON notices that Cameron is wearing mismatched socks.
Um, I was just noticing that you...
Are very attractive!|Are wearing mismatched socks!
Yeah. I am. What do you think about that?
I think you probably forgot to look at your feet this morning.
And is that the educated guess of a girl who takes advanced classes?
It was. Until you questioned the skill of my guess. Now I'm thinking you're just a horrible dresser.
Heh. Good guess. But that's not it.
Cameron gestures toward the B10 end of the hall.
Want me to walk you to your class? I'll steer you clear of cavemen.
That's silly. Why would I encounter any cave--?
--Oh, wait, you were referencing my reference to cavemen, weren't you?
Sure, we can walk... After all, I still don't know the mystery of the mismatched socks.
$ALLISON and Cameron walk toward room B10. The silence hangs between them for a moment.
Silence. That's bad, right? That means I should say something!
Cameron blushes slightly. In turn, $ALLISON blushes dramatically.
Er, not that I am flirting! I meant that objectively your features are very striking. Very... Symmetrical.
Yes! Our brains are hardwired to be attracted to faces with matching left and right halves. It's science.
Sure... For what it's worth, your face is... Uh... Symmetrical too.
Please change the subject. For both our sakes...
All right. I saw you looking at my socks earlier. How about I tell you about them while I'm walking you to class?
Yeah. I don't tell many people about this, but my brother... He's mentally challenged.
He wears his socks this way, so `I` wear my socks this way.
That is surprisingly sweet. It makes me want to hug you.
You're kind of an odd girl, you know that?
I am aware of my proclivity toward blunders in social situations, yes.
And you talk pretty strangely too.
Is this how you charm all the girls?
Well, what can I say? You're--
Suddenly, a girl walks in between them and grabs Cameron by the arm, pulling him away!
Come with me, Cam. You're going to be late for class.
Both Cameron and the girl look back at $ALLISON. While Cameron's look is apologetic, the girl's is far from it.
Well, looks like I've already made an enemy before the first class...
... This day is going about as badly as expected...
$ALLISON turns the corner toward Advanced English class, and an angry, short-haired, blonde girl blocks her path!
What do you think you're doing talking to Cameron?
I ran into him, much the same way I did with you. It's really not my day for walking unimpeded...
Really? I just saw a different girl head off with--
Yeah, that was my friend! And I told her to take Cameron away from you!
Are you making fun of me?
No, `actually,` I'm making fun of me. I'm in no way a threat to... To... Your man.
Although he is admittedly quite handsome...
In fact, I'm surprised by how much I was initially taken with him... Particularly his eyes, which are a lot like pools... Of...
$ALLISON trails off, noticing the look of pure anger on Veronica's face.
I've said too much, haven't I?
Veronica knocks $ALLISON's books out of her hand, sending them flying!
As $ALLISON begins picking them up, a crowd forms around her and Veronica.
Cameron and I are dating! That means you don't talk to him, stand near him, or `look` at him. Is that clear?!
Your request is completely impossible to uphold. I can't control what I look at. Once I've looked at something, it's already happened.
Now, if you'll excuse me, I must get to class.
$ALLISON rises and notices that Veronica is holding her Advanced English book. Veronica flips it open, reading $ALLISON's name written on the inside cover.
Allison `Applebee.` You're Amanda Applebee's sister aren't you? Does that mean you got none of the looks and all of the nerdy brains?
Blood rushes to $ALLISON's face. She snatches her book back and tries to walk around Veronica, but Veronica sidesteps, blocking her again!
Okay, breathe, $ALLISON. What would Amanda do?
Nerdy brains? Are you saying I have more than one?
Wait... Are you actually `pretending` to be as air-headed as your sister? That's `so` messed up!
No! I only thought Amanda's brand of simple-minded innocence might disarm your foolish, irrational anger!
So... We agree your sister's an idiot?
You know, you might be smarter than she is, but it's pretty clear you're just as clueless!
Listen, I think we've gotten off on the wrong foot. Yes, I am Amanda's sister, and I'd... I'd appreciate it if you didn't insult her.
Additionally, while I find you to be crude, aggressive, and obnoxious in a way that can only imply bad parenting...
I think there `is` something quite sweet about the way you're protecting Cameron. So... Kudos for that!

You're just like your sister, huh? A complete idiot!
Veronica tries to shove $ALLISON, but immediately, $ALLISON's judo training takes over!
I told you not to insult my sister!
$ALLISON grabs at Veronica's hand and pulls, but her tenuous grip causes Veronica to fly into her!
As $ALLISON stumbles backwards, Veronica's elbow connects with her eye!
But then Veronica trips over $ALLISON's feet and falls hard to the floor!
Okay, that wasn't a `classic` judo move... But the end result was intentional.
$ALLISON grabs Veronica's wrist, thrusts her hip forward, and flips her with a clean throw!
Veronica lands hard on her back, $ALLISON still holding her by the wrist!
See? I used her own momentum `against` her. That is the very principle of judo. Did anyone see that? Anyone?
$ALLISON looks up and sees the shocked faces on the crowd. She looks down and sees the pain on Veronica's face.
Before $ALLISON can say anything, Ms. Lee comes storming in through the crowd.
What is this nonsense going on in my hallway?! An attack on a defenseless student? Inexcusable!

pov_note: Multi-POV episode. `pov` on a segment is the playable character in control on entry; a node's `set_pov` switches the current POV mid-stream (these are the game's 'You are now playing as X' cards). A dialogue node's `side` is 'left' when the speaker is the current POV (the game shows the current main on the left) and 'right' otherwise. POV is propagated in execution order from `entry`; only main_characters can hold it.
